goal: Rebuild the Runner dashboard into a project-first human control plane for projects, first-class agents, assignments, ownership, overlap, repository hygiene, QA, consolidation, handoffs and infrastructure state, with no paid AI requirement for core workflows.

protected_ownership.runner_inspector_infrastructure_agent: owns provider capacity, retry/defer policy, execution scheduling and Inspector evidence infrastructure; 3.0 UI consumes those capabilities rather than reimplementing them
protected_ownership.project_product_truth: target repositories remain authoritative for product truth

tranches.name: data model + read-only project control plane
required: agents registry distinct from scheduler automations

tranches.name: guarded assignment + repo actions
required: safe cleanup dry run and execution

tranches.name: polish + migration
required: move existing scheduler controls to Automations

non_goals: semantic reconciliation of contradictory prose without human review
acceptance_criteria: A user can see every managed project and attention state from one dashboard.
A project view shows stage, workers, assignments, branches, PRs, QA, overlap and blockers.
First-class project agents are distinct from Runner scheduler automations.
Overlap is derived deterministically and exposes exact causative paths.
Assignments can be managed from the dashboard with guarded writes.
Repo hygiene can identify orphan, stale, merged and superseded work.
Safe cleanup can execute from the dashboard without force operations.
Structured status and trackers can be consolidated without paid inference.
Codex/ChatGPT handoff packets can be generated with one click without model calls.
QA failure classes distinguish product failures from provider/harness states.
Infrastructure capacity can be viewed from Runner.
Core 3.0 remains fully useful with no OPENAI_API_KEY.
implementation_note: Do not build the whole release as one mega-branch. Implement each 3.0 tranche through bounded short-lived branches/PRs and preserve the existing visual evidence surface and current control functionality during migration.
